responses.text: {Player not in NCR gear} {pleased} A customer! Not many people come into Boulder City these days.
{Player in NCR gear} Howdy, trooper. I thought the Big Horn was off limits to you guys, but who am I to complain? A customer is a customer.
{Great Khans left alive} Surprising that the Khans are going to walk out of here after all that fuss.
{Great Khans dead} Guess those Khans got what was coming to them, huh?
{NCR troops dead} Hope those Great Khans don't come trash my saloon. I'm not part of the NCR!
Welcome back to the Big Horn. What can I get you?
{Quarry Junction Deathclaws dead} Most of the limestone comes from Quarry Junction out west. The supply had stopped for awhile because of a Deathclaw problem.
I heard some badass wastelander killed the Deathclaws, and deliveries of limestone have been coming in again.
I don't think they've gotten the trains up and running yet, but most of the concrete plant workers have come back to town now. Good for business.
{Quarry Junction Deathclaws not dead} Most of the limestone comes from Quarry Junction out west, but I hear some Deathclaws overran the quarry.
With no work to be had, all the workers around here have wandered off. I'm the only one left in town.

topics.prompt: Where does the concrete come from?

responses.text: Come back real soon!
Oh. Well, you'd better not let any of the real troopers hear that - and, of course, they won't be hearing it from me, neither.
So, what brings you to Boulder City? Not many people come here.

topics.prompt: I'm not a trooper. I just happen to be wearing the armor.

responses.text: What can I get you?

topics.prompt: Show me what you have for sale.

responses.text: The workers here don't much like the military. After too many fights and broken noses, the NCR doesn't allow troops to spend time here.
That doesn't stop a few people like yourself, of course. Don't worry, I won't say a word.

topics.prompt: Why is the Big Horn off limits to troopers?

responses.text: Most of the town is rubble - destroyed during the Battle of Hoover Dam - and the only other thing around here is the concrete mixing yard.
The NCR has been constructing bunkers up and down the river. From what I've heard, it's a little late for that.
Travelers over at the 188 - just up the road - said that the Legion has overrun a couple of towns to the south.
Come back real soon!
